purpose: Prototype of a compact (sparse_matmul INDEXED/GATHER) batch>1 decode MoE plus an inactive-row routing mask, validated for PCC against the shipped union path and timed against it, on one real MoE layer at B=32. Includes the full routing prologue, so these are whole-routed-expert-block numbers, not just the post-matmul chain.
synthetic_activation_caveat: SYNTHETIC ACTIVATIONS: routing is driven by torch.randn(1,1,B,hidden)*0.02, not by real hidden states. Measured (moe_union_width.json): randn selects a union of 52 of 64 experts at 32 rows, while the real model's decode union at 32 live rows averages 32.2 (median 32, range 20-48). Per-layer comparisons at a FIXED active count are unaffected and are what this file is for; any comparison that lets the union path's active count float -- notably compact kc=n_experts vs union at 32 rows -- is biased toward the compact form here and must be taken from the whole-model arm (adapter_decode_floor_kc64.json vs adapter_decode_floor_after.json) instead.
